15 years of #linuxaudio, 30 years of breaking down boundaries between #blackmetal, #electronic, and avant-garde music. 


Today, I am excited to present an in-depth Spotlight Artist #interview with Norwegian multi-instrumentalist and #musicproducer Tor-Helge Skei. 😎️


In this extensive deep dive, Tor-Helge speaks about #musicmaking, health, and #programming, and all of that, of course, in a nerdy #linux context. 🤓️


https://linuxaudio.dev/artists-spotlight/tor-helge-skei
